limitations: Finite current code/config/task/seed coverage does not establish universal nonuse or safe deletion.
No full rollout, interactive collection, live PlantController/servo session, rendering, replay, or repeated reset audited.
Later runtime branches, untested seeds, external scripts/configurations, and unavailable historical records remain unverified.
Manifest sweep synthetic source declarations do not represent every possible production scene parameterization.
Concurrent generated-robot/compiler changes prevent claiming one frozen robot snapshot across cases.
Zero runtime opens does not establish original source/license provenance or historical ownership.
Only the 4661 unknown OBJ files audited here; the two unknown JSON files remain outside this scope.
